subperms.label: See All Users on Dashboard (Leaderboard and Tasks)
subperms.description: Lets the user see all active users, not just teammates, on their Dashboard Leaderboard and Tasks.

subperms.label: Edit Header Message
subperms.description: Lets the user edit or reset the header message at the top of the app, and see its edit history.

label: REPORTS
description: Category for all permissions related to reports

subperms.label: See Analytics Reports
subperms.description: Lets the user open Reports > Reports and People Reports.

subperms.label: See Weekly Summaries
subperms.description: Lets the user open the Weekly Summaries Report, view and email the Total Org Summary, and see Google Doc icons in Dashboard Tasks.

subperms.label: See PR Dashboard and Edit PR Grading Dashboard
subperms.description: Lets the user see the PR Dashboard menu, open 'PR Team Analysis Dashboard' and 'PR Analytics', and edit the PR Grading Dashboard.

subperms.label: Edit Total Valid Weekly Summaries
subperms.description: Lets the user change each person's 'Total Valid Weekly Summaries' count on the Weekly Summaries Report.

subperms.label: See Highlight for Bios Eligible to be Posted
subperms.description: Shows the 'Bio Status' filter and highlights in yellow who is eligible for a bio on the Weekly Summaries Report.

subperms.label: Toggle Request Bio
subperms.description: Lets the user change a person's 'Bio announcement' switch on the Weekly Summaries Report.

subperms.label: See Volunteer Weekly Summaries
subperms.description: Lets the user open Reports > Volunteer Summary Reports.

subperms.label: Edit Team Codes
subperms.description: Lets the user change team codes on the profile Teams tab, or on the Weekly Summaries Report one by one or in bulk.

subperms.label: Create, Edit and Delete Weekly Summaries Filter
subperms.description: Lets the user create, edit and delete saved filters on the Weekly Summaries Report.

subperms.label: See Job Analytics Reports
subperms.description: Lets the user open Reports > Job Analytics Report.

label: USER MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to user management

subperms.label: See All Users (User List and User Management)
subperms.description: Lets the user see the full list of users in User Management and on pages that list all users.

subperms.label: Create New Users
subperms.description: Lets the user create new users with the 'Create New User' and 'Send Setup Link' buttons on User Management.

subperms.label: Edit User Profile
subperms.description: Lets the user edit other users' basic profile, like name, bio and photo.

subperms.label: Change User Status
subperms.description: Lets the user activate or deactivate users with the green/red status dot.

subperms.label: Toggle Invisibility Permission Self and Others
subperms.description: Lets the user hide or show any user, including themselves, to teammates with the profile's Visibility switch.

subperms.label: Interact with Pause User button
subperms.description: Lets the user pause a user until a chosen date, or resume them, from User Management or their profile.

subperms.label: Assign Blue Squares
subperms.description: Lets the user give any user a blue square with the '+' in the Blue Squares section of their profile.

subperms.label: Edit Blue Squares
subperms.description: Lets the user change the date and summary of any user's blue square from their profile.

subperms.label: Delete Blue Squares
subperms.description: Lets the user delete any user's blue square from their profile.

subperms.label: Modify Important User Info
subperms.description: Lets the user change protected profile fields like role, hours, dates, teams and status. Also needs 'Edit User Profile'.

subperms.label: Edit Summary Submit Requirement (Others)
subperms.description: Lets the user choose if another user must submit weekly summaries, on their profile. Also needs 'Edit User Profile'.

subperms.label: Update Password (Others)
subperms.description: Lets the user reset another user's password with 'Reset Password' in User Management or on their profile.

subperms.label: Manage Time Off Requests
subperms.description: Lets the user add, edit and delete any user's time off in User Management, and go past the 4-week limit.

subperms.label: Change Rehireable Status
subperms.description: Lets the user mark any user as rehireable or not rehireable on their profile.

subperms.label: Set Final Day
subperms.description: Lets the user set or remove a user's final day, which schedules their deactivation.

subperms.label: HGN People +/- Setup
subperms.description: Lets the user invite people to GitHub, Dropbox, Sentry and Slack, remove them from GitHub and Sentry, and delete their Dropbox folder.

subperms.label: View Tracking Overview
subperms.description: Shows a 'Tracking' button for each team member on Dashboard > Tasks, to see their warning dots (view only).

subperms.label: Issue Tracking Warnings
subperms.description: Lets the user click the tracking dots on Dashboard > Tasks to log warnings and send warning emails.

subperms.label: Issue a Blue Square
subperms.description: Lets the user issue a blue square from a tracking warning.

subperms.label: Delete a Single Warning
subperms.description: Lets the user delete one warning (a colored dot) from a person on Dashboard > Tasks. Also needs 'Issue Tracking Warnings'.

subperms.label: Add a New Warning Tracker
subperms.description: Lets the user add warning trackers (rows of tracking dots for everyone) with '+/-' on Dashboard > Tasks.

subperms.label: Deactivate a Warning Tracker
subperms.description: Lets the user turn off a warning tracker with '-' in the '+/-' window on Dashboard > Tasks, hiding it for everyone.

subperms.label: Reactivate a Warning Tracker
subperms.description: Lets the user turn a switched-off warning tracker back on with '+' in the '+/-' window on Dashboard > Tasks.

subperms.label: Delete a Warning Tracker (and All Its Warnings)
subperms.description: Lets the user permanently delete a warning tracker ('x' in the '+/-' window on Dashboard > Tasks) and its warnings for everyone.

label: BADGE MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to badge management

subperms.label: See Badges
subperms.description: Shows Other Links > Badge Management (view only) and 'Load Badges'/'Load Trophies' on the Weekly Summaries Report.

subperms.label: Create Badges
subperms.description: Lets the user create badges with 'Create New Badge' on Other Links > Badge Management (not edit or delete them).

subperms.label: Edit Badge
subperms.description: Lets the user edit existing badges (name, image, description, ranking) on Other Links > Badge Management.

subperms.label: Delete Badge
subperms.description: Lets the user delete a badge on Other Links > Badge Management. This also removes it from everyone who earned it.

subperms.label: Modify Badge Amount
subperms.description: Lets the user change badge counts in a person's badge history (profile > 'Select Featured').

subperms.label: Assign Badges
subperms.description: Lets the user give badges to people (Other Links > Badge Management > Badge Assignment, or 'Assign Badges' on a profile).

label: PROJECT MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to projects

subperms.label: Add Project
subperms.description: Lets the user create new projects with 'Add New Project' on Other Links > Projects.

subperms.label: Delete Project
subperms.description: Lets the user archive or unarchive projects on Other Links > Projects.

subperms.label: Edit Project Category or Status
subperms.description: Lets the user rename projects, change their category and set them Active/Inactive on Other Links > Projects.

subperms.label: See User in Project
subperms.description: Lets the user see who is on each project (Other Links > Projects > Members) and use 'Generate Summary Intro' on profiles.

subperms.label: Assign Project to Users
subperms.description: Lets the user add or remove people on any project from its Members page on Other Links > Projects.

subperms.label: WORK BREAKDOWN STRUCTURES
subperms.description: Category for all permissions related to work breakdown structures

subperms.label: Add WBS
subperms.description: Lets the user add a new WBS (work breakdown structure) to any project on Other Links > Projects > WBS.

subperms.label: Delete WBS
subperms.description: Lets the user delete any WBS with the red minus button on a project's WBS page.

subperms.label: TASKS
subperms.description: Category for all permissions related to tasks

subperms.label: Add Task
subperms.description: Lets the user add tasks and subtasks to any WBS with 'Add Task' (Other Links > Projects > WBS > choose a WBS).

subperms.label: Edit Task
subperms.description: Lets the user edit any task directly (WBS > EDIT > Edit) and approve suggested task changes from the header.

subperms.label: Delete Task
subperms.description: Lets the user delete any task and its subtasks (WBS > EDIT > Remove, or Delete on the task's page).

subperms.label: Resolve Tasks
subperms.description: Lets the user mark a person's task as done with the green check on Dashboard > Tasks.

subperms.label: Suggest Changes on a task
subperms.description: Lets the user open a task from Dashboard > Tasks and send changes with 'Suggest' instead of editing it directly.

subperms.label: Unassign Team Members from Tasks
subperms.description: Lets the user take a person off a task with the red X on Dashboard > Tasks.

subperms.label: Interact with Task "Ready for Review"
subperms.description: Lets the user act on a 'Ready for Review' task on Dashboard > Tasks: mark it complete or send it back.

subperms.label: View and Interact with Task "X" on Dashboards
subperms.description: Lets the user see and use the task 'X' on Dashboard > Tasks.

subperms.label: Unassign Team Members from Tasks
subperms.description: Lets the user unassign their team members from tasks on the Dashboard.

subperms.label: See How Many Times a Task's Estimated Hours Changed
subperms.description: Shows, next to each task's hours on Dashboard > Tasks, how many times its estimated hours changed; click for the history.

subperms.label: View and Interact with Task Deadlines Boxes
subperms.description: Lets the user see and tick the follow-up (deadline) boxes next to task progress on Dashboard > Tasks.

label: TEAMS MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to team management

subperms.label: Edit Team
subperms.description: Lets the user rename teams and set them Active or Inactive on Other Links > Teams.

subperms.label: Delete Team
subperms.description: Lets the user delete a team on Other Links > Teams. It is permanent and removes the team from every member's profile.

subperms.label: CREATE/ASSIGN TEAMS
subperms.description: Quality of life bundling of two permissions commonly used together

subperms.label: Create Team
subperms.description: Lets the user open Other Links > Teams and create new teams with the 'Create New Team' button.

subperms.label: Assign Users to Team
subperms.description: Lets the user open Other Links > Teams and add or remove team members, there or on a user's profile.

label: TIMELOG MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to timelog management

subperms.label: Toggle Tangible Time Self
subperms.description: Lets the user switch their own time entries between Tangible and Intangible with the Tangible checkbox.

subperms.label: TIMELOG MANAGEMENT (OWN)
subperms.description: Category for all permissions related to timelog management

subperms.label: Delete Time Entry (Own)
subperms.description: Lets the user delete their own time entries with the trash icon on their Time Log.

subperms.label: TIMELOG MANAGEMENT (OTHERS)
subperms.description: Category for all permissions related to timelog management

subperms.label: Add Time Entry (Others)
subperms.description: Lets the user add time entries to other people's Time Logs.

subperms.label: Delete Time Entry (Others)
subperms.description: Lets the user delete other people's time entries.

subperms.label: EDITING TIME ENTRIES
subperms.description: Category for all permissions related to editing timelogs

subperms.label: Edit Timelog Time (Self and Others)
subperms.description: Lets the user change the hours and minutes of any time entry, their own or others', with the edit pencil.

subperms.label: Edit Timelog Description (Self and Others)
subperms.description: Lets the user change the notes of any time entry, their own or others', with the edit pencil.

subperms.label: Toggle Tangible Time Others
subperms.description: Lets the user switch other people's time entries between Tangible and Intangible with the Tangible checkbox.

subperms.label: Change Time Entry Date (Self and Others)
subperms.description: Lets the user pick or change the date of a time entry, their own or others', when adding or editing it.

subperms.label: Send Emails
subperms.description: Lets the user email chosen people or all subscribers, and post to Mastodon, from Other Links > Send Emails.

label: PERMISSIONS MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to permissions management

subperms.label: Add Roles
subperms.description: Lets the user create a new role with chosen permissions, using 'Add New Role' in Permissions Management.

subperms.label: Delete Roles
subperms.description: Lets the user delete a role, if they also have 'Edit Roles'. Everyone in that role becomes a Volunteer; this cannot be undone.

subperms.label: Edit Roles
subperms.description: Lets the user see all roles, rename them and change their permissions in Permissions Management.

subperms.label: Edit Individual User Permissions
subperms.description: Lets the user edit one person's permissions in Permissions Management. Also needs 'See All Users (User List and User Management)'.

label: POPUP MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to popup management

subperms.label: Edit Popups
subperms.description: Lets the user change the text of confirmation pop-ups, like delete task.

label: QUICK SETUP FUNCTIONS
description: Category for permissions related to Quick Setup functions.

subperms.label: Add New Title
subperms.description: Lets the user create new Quick Setup Titles and change their order on a user's profile page.

subperms.label: Assign Title
subperms.description: Lets the user apply a Quick Setup Title on a profile, setting the person's teams, project and links.

subperms.label: Edit Titles
subperms.description: Lets the user change existing Quick Setup Titles with the Edit button on a user's profile.

label: MISC/UNSORTED
description: Category for all permissions not related to other categories

subperms.label: Access HGN Skills Dashboard
subperms.description: Lets the user open another member's HGN Skills profile page.

subperms.label: Access PM Resource Dashboard
subperms.description: Lets the user open the PM Resource Dashboard for resource requests and educator certifications.

subperms.label: Blue Square Email Management
subperms.description: Lets the user open Blue Square Email Management to resend last week's blue square emails and the weekly summary report email.

subperms.label: Manage User State Indicator
subperms.description: Lets the user set a person's state indicator on the Weekly Summaries Report.

label: FAQS
description: Category for all permissions related to FAQs

subperms.label: Manage FAQs
subperms.description: Lets the user add, edit and delete FAQs and see unanswered questions on the FAQ Management page.

label: JOB FORM MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to job application form management

subperms.label: Create Form Questions
subperms.description: Lets the user add questions to job forms and save new templates in the Job Question Set Builder. Also needs 'Manage Job Forms'.

subperms.label: Edit Form Questions
subperms.description: Lets the user edit and reorder questions and update templates in the Job Question Set Builder. Also needs 'Manage Job Forms'.

subperms.label: Delete Form Questions
subperms.description: Lets the user delete job form questions and templates in the Job Question Set Builder. Also needs 'Manage Job Forms'.

subperms.label: Manage Job Forms
subperms.description: Lets the user create or delete job forms and see applicants' answers in the Job Question Set Builder.

label: ACTIVITY LOG MANAGEMENT
description: Category for all permissions related to activity logs

subperms.label: Education Portal: View Student Daily Logs
subperms.description: Lets the user view an Education Portal student's daily log.

subperms.label: Education Portal: Mark Student Logs as Assisted
subperms.description: Lets the user mark an Education Portal student's daily log as 'assisted'.
